description.value:
Using magic to pull back the veil on one object or creature, you learn the magical secrets that it holds.

The effect of this spell changes based on the target:

  • Objects: Learn all of the following:
    • Identify Object: What the object is and its general purpose.
      For example, you would learn that a key is designed to open a lock, not what lock it is meant to open.
    • Identify Magic: If the object is a magic item, or if it has a spell or magical effect cast on it, and what the magic item or spell on it is called.
    • Identify Magic Origin: If the object was created by a spell and which spell was used to create it.
  • Creatures: Learn all of the following:
    • Identify Effects: Which spells, conditions, and magical effects are affecting the creature, but not what they do.
    • Identify Creature Type: The creature’s type and core attributes.
    • Identify Attunement: Which items on their person they are attuned to, but not what they are capable of.

Charge: This spell can be Charged, modifying its effects for a cost:

  • A Clear Crystal worth 50gp: Additionally…
    • Identify Magic Item: Identify the magic item.
    • Identify Spell Effects: Learn the nature of the spell(s) affecting the object.
  • A Clear Crystal worth 100gp: Additionally… 
    • Identify Creature: Learn the creature’s true name and face, and a secret about them.
    • Identify Durability: Learn the creature’s weaknesses, resistances, and immunities.
    • Identify Spell Effects: Learn the nature of the spell(s) affecting the creature.
